name: CodeEditor
description: Editable code in a native textarea, with file tabs, a language select, line numbers, the active line, diagnostics listed in text and a status bar. Code stays left to right in RTL.

props.name: language
props.description: The code's language, shown in the status bar and selected in the language select.

props.name: languages
props.description: Options for the language select, as strings or { value, label }. The select renders when there are any.

props.name: tabs
props.description: File tabs, as strings or { value, label }. They render as a tablist over the code.

props.name: tab
props.description: The selected tab's value. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: diagnostics
props.description: Problems as { line, column?, message, severity? } (error, warning or info). Marked in the gutter and listed in text under the code.

props.name: tabSize
props.description: Spaces Tab inserts, shown in the status bar.

props.name: rows
props.description: The fewest lines shown. The editor grows with its content.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the editor, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control. Emitted as data-disabled.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Makes the code read-only. It stays focusable and selectable. Emitted as data-readonly.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required (and so aria-required) on the control.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Never a replacement for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The code. Livewire binds it with wire:model on the textarea, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled editor.

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: The file tablist's accessible name. Defaults to "Open files", translated in Livewire.

props.name: languageLabel
props.description: The language select's accessible name. Defaults to "Language", translated in Livewire.

props.name: positionLabel
props.description: The caret position in the status bar; :line and :column are numbers. Defaults to "Ln :line, Col :column", translated in Livewire.

props.name: spacesLabel
props.description: The indentation in the status bar; :count is tabSize. Defaults to "Spaces: :count", translated in Livewire.

props.name: errorCountLabel
props.description: The status bar's count for one error. Defaults to ":count error", translated in Livewire.

props.name: errorsCountLabel
props.description: The status bar's error count; :count is the number. Defaults to ":count errors", translated in Livewire.

props.name: warningCountLabel
props.description: The status bar's count for one warning. Defaults to ":count warning", translated in Livewire.

props.name: warningsCountLabel
props.description: The status bar's warning count; :count is the number. Defaults to ":count warnings", translated in Livewire.

props.name: problemsLabel
props.description: The diagnostics list's accessible name. Defaults to "Problems", translated in Livewire.

props.name: lineLabel
props.description: A diagnostic's line; :line is the number. Defaults to "Line :line", translated in Livewire.

props.name: severityErrorLabel
props.description: The visually hidden severity name of an error. Defaults to "Error", translated in Livewire.

props.name: severityWarningLabel
props.description: The visually hidden severity name of a warning. Defaults to "Warning", translated in Livewire.

props.name: severityInfoLabel
props.description: The visually hidden severity name of an info diagnostic. Defaults to "Info", translated in Livewire.

props.name: instructionsLabel
props.description: The visually hidden keyboard instructions linked to the control. Defaults to "Tab inserts indentation. To leave the editor, press Escape, then Tab.", translated in Livewire.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { gutter: '…', control: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered frame: header, body, diagnostics and status. The spec's root.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The bar over the code with the tabs and the language select. Renders with tabs or languages.

parts.name: tabs
parts.description: The file tabs, role=tablist with roving focus.

parts.name: tab
parts.description: One file tab, role=tab with aria-selected.

parts.name: languageSelect
parts.description: The native language select, with an accessible name.

parts.name: body
parts.description: The gutter beside the control, left to right in every direction. The tab panel when there are tabs.

parts.name: gutter
parts.description: Line numbers. Hidden from screen readers.

parts.name: line
parts.description: One line number, with data-active on the caret's line and data-severity on lines with diagnostics.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native textarea. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: diagnostics
parts.description: The diagnostics listed in text, so they're never only a mark.

parts.name: diagnostic
parts.description: One diagnostic: an icon, its line and message, with data-severity.

parts.name: status
parts.description: The status bar: problems, the caret's line and column, indentation and language.

parts.name: instructions
parts.description: Visually hidden keyboard instructions, linked to the control with aria-describedby.

events.name: tab-change
events.description: A tab was selected. The app swaps the value for that file.

events.name: language-change
events.description: A language was chosen in the select.

keyboard.action: Inside the code, indents or outdents the line or every selected line by tabSize spaces.
Leaves the editor: after Escape, Tab and Shift+Tab move focus as usual.
Moves between file tabs and selects them, following the text direction; Home and End go to the first and last.

requirements: The label is always visible and linked with for/id.
Tab inserts indentation; the way out (Escape, then Tab) is documented and read out through the instructions linked to the control.
Diagnostics are listed in text with their line and severity, not only marked in the gutter.
The file tabs are a tablist with one tab stop, and arrow keys follow the text direction (RTL); the body is their tab panel.
Hint, error and the instructions are linked to the control with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
The code and gutter stay left to right in RTL; the header and status bar mirror (D-004).
Colors come from tokens, so the editor follows the theme: never a hard-coded dark editor inside a light theme.
Class goes to the root; every other attribute (wire:model, name) goes to the control.
